nodes.label: Global Promise-based useConfirm System
nodes.rationale: Confirm dialogs are awaited as Promises via context (ConfirmContext + ConfirmProvider resolverRef) so any component can 'await confirm()'. Hotfix 2.2.1 isolates clicks with preventDefault/stopPropagation in the capturing phase to prevent ghost clicks on focused elements beneath the modal; framer-motion spring animation (bounce 0.3, duration 0.4).

nodes.label: Zustand useSyncStore Logout Guard
nodes.rationale: usePhotoUpload calls startSync()/finishSync() (in finally) on the Zustand useSyncStore; useAuth.logout blocks sign-out while isSyncing is true and shows a toast warning, so background photo uploads are never lost by logging out mid-upload.

nodes.label: Standardized lucide-react Icon System
nodes.rationale: Legacy icon libraries (@heroicons/react, react-icons, @fortawesome, Google Material Symbols fonts) were fully removed in favor of a single lucide-react icon system with consistent sizing and animate-spin loading indicators.

nodes.label: Strict Time Tracking Logic (timeTracking.ts)
nodes.rationale: startWork(siteId) INSERTs a time_entries row with start_time and sets site status to in_progress, backfilling actual_start if NULL. completeWork(siteId) backfills actual_start and inserts a closed entry when work is completed without starting, and closes all open entries (end_time IS NULL). Mutations invalidate admin_activity_feed, admin_dashboard_stats and admin_active_sites_online query keys for live admin updates.

nodes.label: Mobile Auto-Navigation After Start Work
nodes.rationale: After pressing 'Pradėti darbą' in the list, installers are auto-redirected to /m/site/{id} so they don't have to hunt for a 'Continue work' button.

nodes.label: Installer Management Module Plan
nodes.rationale: Planned admin module replacing the inactive 'Montuotojai' (Beta) menu item: installer profiles with search/status filtering, per-installer statistics (completed sites, time entries, efficiency), and invitation/creation/permission management.
